meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一篇文章或一段笔记变成带字幕、动效和图表的讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把文字稿快速做成没有实拍画面的讲解短视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn an article or notes into an explainer video with captions, motion graphics and charts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn written drafts into short explainer videos without filming

howto.what: 把一段文字(文章、笔记、话题或简报)做成无真人出镜的解说视频:没有素材可拍,画面按场景现编——排版、抽象图形、图表、数据可视化。产出分镜稿、脚本和最终视频。
howto.when: 当你提供一篇文章、笔记或某个话题/简报,想做成解说视频(概念拆解、操作教程、清单等)时接管;不负责从网站抓取的推广或导览视频。

say.text: 把这篇讲复利的文章做成一段无出镜解说视频
say.note: 先出分镜方案等你确认

say.text: 用男声给这份操作教程配音
say.note: 按你指定的声音生成旁白

say.text: 把这个话题做成 60 秒的清单式解说
say.note: 按简报里的时长预期出片

howto.what_en: Turns text — an article, notes, a topic or brief — into a faceless explainer video: nothing is captured, so visuals are invented per scene (typography, graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Outputs a storyboard, script and final video.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you hand over an article, notes or a topic/brief to make an explainer video (concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles). Not for promo or tour videos captured from a website.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into a faceless explainer video
say_en.note: You get a storyboard to approve first

say_en.text: Use a male voice for this how-to narration
say_en.note: Narration is generated with that voice

say_en.text: Make a 60-second listicle explainer on this topic
